objective: Integrate child slice receipts serially into their owning plan-run branch with recoverable conflicts and aggregate proof
prefetch: Inspect the current source-HEAD-equals-base integration guard
Build two same-base disjoint child branches in a disposable repository
Capture Git conflict and post-integration proof behavior before editing
constraints: The coordinator alone integrates receipts and advances integration_head
Expected coordinator head movement is allowed while outside movement fails compare-and-swap validation
Conflict recovery preserves branch, worktree, receipt, and lease
Worker proof never replaces source-side aggregate proof
acceptance_criteria: Two disjoint same-base receipts integrate serially into the plan-run branch
Integration cannot target an arbitrary checked-out branch
Unexpected outside head movement fails closed
Conflicts and aggregate-proof failures remain recoverable
model_tier_reason: Serialized Git integration and conflict recovery can corrupt history or lose work when subtly wrong
escalation_triggers: Integration runs in an arbitrary source branch
Authorized prior integration is treated as stale base
